svg.title: Mockup 06: Restore from cold on the fallback laptop
svg.text: 06 · Restore from cold: one command on the fallback laptop, against the 30-minute target (superadmin)
Use case: Saturday 21:12 the VM is lost; the on-call person decides at 21:17 to move Demo Event to the laptop. U1, U6, D1, D2, D3, D5, E1, E8.
fallback laptop · on-call

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: Move back after the event: setup/fallback demote
What the restore checks before it says done (D5)
The key opens a sealed test value (else it names each secret it cannot open, E5) · migrations match the release (E6) · every module's health is ok · counts
per event match the backup's manifest · one screen of each live event renders.
It refuses a dump newer than the laptop's release and says how to sync the images (setup/fallback sync).
THE TIME LINE (D2)
The VM stops answering
The watchdog alerts (D9)
A person decides: promote
promote starts; fence written (E1)
Database and files restored
Verified (D5): primary
Screens follow by themselves (U6)
Target: 30 min after the decision
Without the warm copy (D1 A) the restore pulls base and WAL over the
venue uplink: about 15 minutes more, and impossible when the uplink is
what failed.
The weekly CI drill runs the same command on the demo stack and posts its
time (O4).
